title: Your five prayers
tomorrow: Fatima asked her father for help with the work. what did she get?
last: A WEEK OF PASSING IT ON.

lines: A LAB FROM TWO TO FIVE.
cards: A lab that runs from two to five. A shift that ends after sunset. A long drive on a Sunday.
Someone who prays opens a prayer-times app and does the math. The prayers are fixed. The day isn't.
So how does a busy day fit them?

teach.b: Start with the verse, in Pickthall's words: "Lo! worship at fixed hours hath been enjoined on the believers." Fixed hours, yes.
But each prayer has a window of time, which the schools of law describe, and that window is where the planning happens. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ gave a picture of why the effort is worth it.
In a hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari, he asks: if a river ran past your door and you bathed in it five times a day, would any dirt be left on you? None, they say. That, he says, is the five prayers.
So keeping them is less about willpower than about a plan. Which prayer falls in which part of your day. Where you'll pray it: a quiet corner, an empty classroom, a parked car.
What you'll do when a window is tight. Travelers have allowances of their own, which the schools spell out differently.
Your five prayers, mapped onto a real week.

how: Islam sets five daily prayers, each within a window of time; students and workers who pray may plan where they'll pray, using a campus prayer room, a quiet office or a clean spot with a prayer mat.

Sahih al-Bukhari: would any dirt be left? none. that is the five prayers.

games.q: a coworker who doesn't pray sees you step out for a prayer break and asks, kindly, why you can't just do all five at night. what's the clearest answer?
o: sure, I could. as long as all five happen, the time doesn't matter.
each prayer has its own window, so I plan where they fall in my day.
every prayer has to happen at its exact first minute, no exceptions.
games.why: 4:103: worship at fixed hours. but each prayer's time is a window, which is why a plan works better than willpower.

practice: Take tomorrow. For each of the five prayers, name where you'll be when its time comes in, and one spot you could pray there. If you don't pray, map one daily pause the same way.
Keep the plan short enough to remember without a screen.
